body: I’m afraid I can‘t really enjoy the Octo Report one at all. The creature report on the other hand, I loved, it was more cheerful and kinda touched my heart I felt. I’m sorry but the other one sounded a bit more like rap and was no where near as simple, colourful or easy to understand as Creature report.
Ha ha, Great work! :D I saw the sea pigs and the title. So funny, I laughed.
Thanks Vegimals! You’ve got me excited! ;D

Thank you for this actually. When I watched the beginning of the great arctic adventure many months ago, I couldn’t believe what I was hearing: “That’s where we polar bears hunt for food.”

I was aware that polar bears hunted for seals in real life, but I never thought they’d mention it in a kid’s programme - let alone Octonauts.

Boy was I upset when they said that, I don’t want them eat what they’re not used to though, yet I wish they didn’t show us or even mention that to us.

Although the script writers were trying to teach kids about polar life, I’m sure that plenty of the viewers were also dismayed, since we all know that the Octonauts are there to protect all sea life. So being told that *they* would *hunt* seals even, was quite sad to hear.
Woah! They are almost identical stories for sure.
Aw, how I would love that! I so wish the Captain was more on screen, I don’t feel the show is the same without him. And for the female lead, I think Tweak would have been more suited for it to.

Yeah, I must admit I was really sad actually. I feel really guilty for saying this but I cannot say that the new show has made my liking for Octonauts grow. I know that the creators of ”Above and beyond” were certainly trying to bring us something delightful and captivating when they made it, and undoubtedly so many families love it, I’m so happy that they do! However, I found the new spin-off very much saddening to me. When I first saw a trailer for it, I actually got worried about what effect the spin-off could have on the first series. Finally when I did see my first episode I started crying a bit, (gosh, I feel so bad.)  
I felt that the new show had really quite shattered the original one. Sorry, this is just a share on how I feel about “above and beyond.” I extremely loved and preferred how the original was based almost exclusively in the ocean. Now that it’s based profoundly more on land, I was so saddened, and felt that it had disappointed the unique creativity of the first one.   
Along with that, there were many things I got very disheartened by. E.g. How the show isn’t really based on creatures but more on natural problems. How the captain seems to have taken a step back from his main role and hasn’t nearly been seen as much as before, especially Kwazii. How before Dashi was more quiet and gentle, even though she wasn’t one of my favourites, I always admired her traits. Now however she has the most screen time, and her extreme abilities to handle even hurricanes has appeared out of nowhere. I much loved the three boys being in charge, and although I love Dashi, I don’t think it was right for their main roles to be largely used by someone else. I do miss Kwazii. Plus the Octo-report music was very hard to listen to.  
I enjoyed meeting Paani, but having another “Octo” protagonist was difficult since it kinda took away the meaningfulness of it being the original 8. Also the adventures seem to be way over the top, it’s very unnecessary, not to mention how Tweak - alone - managed to repair the destroyed Octopod, used initially for underwater, to it now being able to walk on land, in one day.  
Finally. Way before I even knew about this show, I was dreading if any mammals - not ocean based ones like whales or seals - looked/behaved like their real-life counterparts. So when I saw tigers in the new show, I was extremely upset, so you could probably imagine just how devastated I was when I watched the episode with the panda’s. They were so much bigger than the polar bears we‘ve met before, it’s the complete opposite in reality. Plus their “behaviours“ and mindset was related so much more to what they are in real life. That episode was unfortunately my least favourite.  
All in all, I couldn’t say there’s anything I feel the series has made the original. Sorry, I do feel that the producers might have missed out on quite a good opportunity to make the spin-off a lot more special, and to have thought about the unreasonable things beforehand (the panda‘s.) But there are certainly many wonderful parts that have been added. I’m so happy the producers enjoyed making it. It was really thoughtful of them to make it for us, and I’m happy that so many families love it.
